messages.author: 13904eb0f06097b0
messages.subject: Re: Annotation file
parts:
Hi Okonkwo,

You generally need to create the annotation file yourself depending on your experimental design. The best resource for this is in the supplementary of the new MSstats paper (linked below). Essentially you need to map the names of the MS runs to the corresponding condition and bioreplicate.

https://pubs.acs.org/doi/suppl/10.1021/acs.jproteome.2c00834/suppl_file/pr2c00834_si_001.pdf

Devon
